stem: Which of the following scholar has suggested that the Earth has originated from the gases and the dust particles ?
expl: James Jeans and Harold Jeffreys are related to the tidal hypothesis of the origin of Earth. F. Hoyle and Littleton presented the Nova hypothesis and Otto Schmidt gave the hypothesis of gas and dust for the genesis of Earth (Interstellar dust hypothesis). According to this hypothesis, large quantities of gas and dust particles captured by the gravitational force of the sun formed the Earth.
